text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down 2-3% over 24 hours, with altcoins under more pressure, signaling modest risk-off sentiment despite the Fear & Greed index sitting in greed territory. Bitcoin dominance holding near 59% suggests traders are rotating into alts rather than exiting crypto entirely, though the 5-point drop in the greed gauge over a week hints at cooling conviction. The $81B in daily volume is solid but not exceptional, indicating measured rather than panicked trading activity.
